requirements.requirement: The system must accept sponsor credibility data as part of the clinical trial API response payload without rejecting or failing the response.
The system must map sponsor credibility fields from the API response to the frontend data contract defined in ST-001.
The system must pass sponsor credibility data through App.tsx into the MessageBubble rendering pipeline unchanged in structure.
The system must ensure existing clinical trial data fields continue to render correctly when sponsor data is present.
The system must ensure existing clinical trial data fields continue to render correctly when sponsor data is absent.
The system must not throw runtime errors if the sponsor field is missing, null, or undefined in the API response.
The system must support multiple sponsors in the API response and pass all sponsor entries to the rendering pipeline.
The system must preserve sponsor data fidelity without truncation or transformation at the API ingestion layer.
The system must log a structured warning when sponsor data is present but does not match the expected schema contract.
The system must ignore unknown sponsor fields in the API response without breaking rendering.
The system must ensure that sponsor data is included in the message object passed to MessageBubble.tsx for trials that contain sponsor information.
The system must maintain backward compatibility with prior API response formats that do not include sponsor credibility data.
The system must correctly handle partially populated sponsor objects (e.g., missing funding_source or collaborators) without failing the rendering pipeline.
The system must ensure that sponsor data is scoped only to clinical trial messages and not injected into unrelated message types.
The system must handle API responses containing large sponsor datasets without exceeding existing rendering performance thresholds.
